batting.name: FH Allen
batting.dismissal: c Rashid Khan b R Sai Kishore

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c AS Roy b SP Narine

batting.name: N Sindhu
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b SP Narine

batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: c Ramandeep Singh b SR Dubey

batting.name: R Tewatia
batting.dismissal: c A Raghuvanshi b C Green

balls.text: an overthrow gives Green the second. Green lofted this full and fast ball outside off wide of long-off. Sindhu threw to Rashid, who slipped and missed

wide called, but GT review. The break will allow Gill and co a breather. Green was still in the crease, and went hacking at this length ball turning away. The ball is shown to be bang on the wide line, and so it remains a legal ball
Rabada misses the ball at deep midwicket. Green's fifty off 26 balls! Rabada seemed to have overrun to his left, and then missed the ball to his right, as Green hoicked this full ball
googly on middle and off, and driven to long-on
reverse swept over short third. AR has all the tricks in his bag today. This ball dips on a fullish length slightly wide of off, and AR reads the wrong one
on a length, and wide of off. Slapped to extra cover to start with a single

reverse swatted between the keeper and short third. That's 25 off the over. Short in length, and pitching around fifth stump. It finishes closer to off, and AR rides the bounce before playing it late and leaving Gill look frustrated
flung away again. Siraj looks clueless. This time it's a slower ball, but it doesn't matter. Siraj goes full and on leg, and AR moves across to swipe it over fine leg
scooped!! The six tally keeps rising. AR stood deep in the crease, and chipped this attempted yorker from the stumps to go over short fine leg. It turned out to be a full toss, and AR capitalised
good ball... and whipped to fine leg for two. Siraj nails a yorker swinging into middle, and AR plays it late after getting across the stumps

over extra cover!! I think it didn't entirely come off the middle of the bat, but was timed well enough. AR was deep in the crease, and had to slightly open the face of the bat to loft this length ball on middle
wide called this time. It was too high. Siraj again went short and wide of off, but the ball flew off the pitch. AR looked to ramp but missed
AR goes across and looks to scoop, but misses. Short and wide of off from Siraj, and the extra bounce means AR is beaten
bam!! This six spoils the over for GT. A cutter from Rabada just outside off, and the ball gets up just about ideally for Green to have a swat-pull over midwicket
bottom edge to the keeper. Short and outside off, and extra bounce for Rabada. Green went slashing, but mistimed

dropped by Washy!! He's at fine leg, and drops a sitter. Rabada bowled a yorker around middle, and AR went deep in the crease and whipped from slightly across the stumps. He hit that powerfully, and survived the chance
on the bounce to Rashid moving to his left from deep midwicket. Short ball in the corridor outside off, and Green plays a flat pull
shorter side of a length, and a little wide of off. He looks to swat, but can't get it wide enough of Gill at mid-off
driven back into the stumps at the other end. The ball deflects to end up dribbling behind. Green had driven this full delivery down the ground, but couldn't find the gap
a mistimed pull to long-on's left. Short ball around seventh stump, and swat-pulled down the ground

a bouncer, and too high even for someone as tall as Green. Wide not called, but Green reviews. My first impression was that it would be wide, given it went over Green's head, and Green is among the tallest players in the tournament. The replays confirm the ball is above Green's shoulder but actually below his head. Wow! Now I know why I'm not an umpire
good fielding by Rashid. He was at deep cover point, and ran and tumbled to his left to take this on the bounce. Short and outside off, and slashed by AR
an attempted yorker but turns out to be a low full toss. This arrives on off, and Green whips it to deep midwicket
fifty off 33 balls! He guides this length delivery outside off to deep third to raise the milestone
there's no long-off in place, and AR lofts this over Gill at mid-off. A full delivery just outside off from Holder, and AR went through the line
bowls flat and quick, and full on leg. Green goes back to flick to fine leg for two
appeal for lbw, but that seemed to be turning down. Full and dipping on middle and off, and turning in. Green went sweeping, but was hit on the pad box
the googly. Full and wide of off, and Green went thrashing again, but missed
six down the ground!! Fuller ball from Rashid, and Green lets it dip before launching it for six

dropped by Arshad!! It's not sticking into the GT fielders' hands tonight. Arshad was at fine leg, and looked to take it with a reverse cup. But the ball didn't stick as Green went sweeping, and dropped out to go for four
good work by Sindhu. He was at long-off, and moved to his right to save a potential boundary. AR had lofted this full ball around off
goes over the man at extra cover. A mistimed swat from Green, who gets a short and wide-ish ball outside off. Gill runs across to his left from long-off to cut this off
on the bounce to Rashid running in from deep point. AR can't capitalise on this short and wide ball outside off. He seemed to have been beaten by the steep bounce there
no-ball for height!! That may have slipped out of Holder's hand. AR got across the stumps to try and scoop, and Holder ended up landing this ball beyond the stumps. Buttler stopped it to his left
another dot ball. AR gets bat on ball on this cut, but finds point. This ball is short of a length, and seaming in to finish around fifth stump
there comes the awkward extra bounce which a bowler of Holder's height can get. Short of a length, and wide of off, but the ball jumps and goes over AR's bat as he attempts to slash
fullish delivery in the channel just outside off. Punched to extra cover
bowls this full and just outside off. Green pushes this to long-on
angles this across, and bowls fullish and wide of off. Driven to long-off
but it's six still. Amazing batting. This is a short ball on middle and off, and Green goes low after clearing his front leg to pull over deep midwicket
but it's four to deep square leg. Not off the middle of the bat, but four eventually. Green went sweeping at this fuller and slower delivery, but got it off the bottom of the bat
Green backs away, and finds Gill at extra cover after slashing at this length delivery on the stumps
fuller in length, and bam! Green lets this full and slower ball drop on middle and off, and swings cleanly for six over wide long-on
beaten in the air. On a length on off, and pushed to cover
clears midwicket!! Rashid looks irritated. Short in length, and on the stumps. AR transfers his weight back, and rams a pull over the boundary
fuller in length, and just outside off. Clipped to deep midwicket again
short of a length, and just outside off. It turns in, and is pulled to deep midwicket

a miss from Washy, who moves to his left from long-off, but can't get his hand on the ball. Rashid isn't happy. AR had sliced this full ball around off aerially, and finally got four after waiting for the ball to cross Washy
fuller and slower, and on middle. Clipped to long-on for another single
on a full length around off, and straightening. Punched to midwicket
quicker ball, and full outside off. Driven to extra cover with his bottom hand coming off the bat. Gill tumbles to his right to save a single
short of a length on leg, with a hint of turn away. AR mistimes his pull to long-on
quicker and flatter, and on a length on off. Whipped to deep midwicket, and they pinch two
on a fullish length, and outside off. Punched to deep cover point

got him!! Allen looks up to wonder why?! Rashid takes it on the edge of the deep-midwicket boundary. SK tossed this ball up, and went slow and full on leg. Allen got his front leg out of the way and went heaving through the line, only to be caught this time
full, slow and on the stumps. Clipped to short fine leg's left
through wide long-off. Allen perhaps knew it was coming wide of off, and this time he was ready. Another hittable length, and on a line wide enough for Allen to reach out and crash the ball for four
wide line outside off, and beaten. Arshad angles this across, and goes very full and wide of off. Allen has a swat, but misses
bang!! An effortless clip off his pads. And here comes Gill again for a word with Arshad. Allen clears his front leg, and crashes this length delivery over square leg
a length delivery outside leg, and this time Allen finds the fielder. He can only whip this to Holder at short fine leg
over deep midwicket!! That was hit hard and flat, and landed 29 rows deep. Another short delivery from Arshad, and Allen swat-pulls it from the stumps
but that makes no difference. Short delivery from Arshad, and just outside leg. Allen shifts his weight back and swivels for six over fine leg
Floated up on off and Raghuvanshi is onto it in a jiffy! Gets a big stride forward and creams it over long-off. Raghuvanshi playing a nice foil to Allen here
Fired in full and flat on off at 92kph, Raghuvanshi drives to cover
On a length around middle and spinning away, Allen punches it away to the off-side sweeper

And Allen clears the ground again. Allen dances down to this full ball on middle, getting to the pitch of it, and swings away. Doesn't get it off the middle, but even this mishit flies for six over long-on
Waits on this length ball and squeezes it out square on the off side for a quick run

Flung full around leg, Raghuvanshi flicks it away through midwicket and they do well to run two. KKR have had some issues in their running between the wickets, but on this occasion, it was nicely done
Crunched on the pull over deep square leg! 100 up for KKR in nine overs as Allen takes on this short ball. This slower bouncer sits up nicely and Allen says thank you very much as he hammers it away
Holder goes short outside off at 135kph. Allen looks to get on his toes and punch it away square on the off side but is beaten
Back of length outside off, Raghuvanshi punches it out to deep backward point
On a length outside off, he punches at it and gets it off the inside half towards long-on
Picks the bones out of that one! Overpitched outside off and Allen latches onto it in an instant. Gives it a mighty whack over cow corner
Length ball outside off, Raghuvanshi clips it through backward square
On a length on off, punched wide of long-on for a single
Full around off, Raghuvanshi looks to flick it away but gets a leading edge to backward point
Works this length ball out to deep midwicket off his pads

Misfield, and that's a boundary for Allen that takes him to a 21-ball fifty! Punches this length ball down the ground, straight of long-on. Holder gets across to his left and slides, but makes a mess of what should have been a simple stop. The ball deflects onto the ropes
Bang! Two in a row! Rashid tries to pull back his length. It's a googly that's not really a long hop. But he rocks back earlhy, clearing that front leg again, and muscles it over midwicket!
Allen smokes Rashid over long-on! Rashid floated this one up, overpitched around off. Allen clears his front leg and use those long levers to good effect
Salt on wounds applied! That's a poor ball. In the slot and sliding down leg, and Raghuvanshi whips it away over fine leg, with a lovely pickup shot

Siraj has dropped an absolute dolly! Holder cramps Allen for room with a 135kph short ball. Allen still takes it on with the pull and it hits high on the bat. Goes straight to Siraj, who looked set to complete GT's second wicket. But instead it just bounces behind through his hands
On a length and on his pads, whipped away through backward square
Full around off, Allen heaves it along the ground to long-on's right
Full on the stumps, Raghuvanshi helps it along with the angle to deep fine leg
Length ball angled in from outside off, Allen pushes at it and gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball drops to his right and they take a single
Fends this length ball fine on the off side

That's innovative and bold from Raghuvanshi! Length ball outside off, Raghuvanshi gets across and scoops it over the keeper. has to get his own head out of the way as he plays it. Rabada has been bowling at high speeds, and this was a brave shot
Full-ish ball angling in from outside off. Allen squeezes it out behind point
Length ball outside off, he wants to swing it away but can only get it off the inside half to midwicket. 145.8kph

Rabada runs in and fires this full and wide as Allen shuffles across the stumps. Allen shapes for the reverse-ramp but lets it go on account of the ball being very wide. It's given wide, and GT review that decision because they reckon Allen moved early. And after review, the umpire's decision is upheld. So now GT do lose a review

Big shout for lbw as Raghuvanshi misses his flick. The ball deflects towards point and they get a leg bye. GT review. This is a wobble seam delivery on a length outside off comes in with the angle. Beats the bat to rap him above the knee roll on the front pad. Oh, that's so close! It's just clipping the leg bail, so it's umpire's call! GT will keep the review, but they know they were very close to another big wicket
142.5 length ball outside off, Raghuvanshi stands tall and punches it to cover
Full ball jags in from outside off. Raghuvanshi drops it in front of point and they get a single
Full outside off, Raghuvanshi can only tap it towards cover
Siraj again fires one down the leg side as Raghuvanshi dances down to try and whip it away
Now Siraj messes up his radar, firing a wild wide down the leg side

Oh, what a jaffa! On a good length outside off, threatening to shape away, and Raghuvanshi shoulders arms. but this one jags back in and Raghuvanshi is lucky the length meant the ball goes over the stumps

Siraj knocks him over, and out comes the SIIIUUU-lebration It's a 200th T20 wicket for Siraj and it's brought up in some style. Fuller this time, hint of shape away, but it just seams in a touch. Rahane plays all around it as he tries to whip it away and he turns around to watch his middle stump out of the ground
Leading edge, but it clears the infield! Rahane looks to flick this length ball away but is early into the shot. The leading edge flies over short third and Rahane picks up a lucky boundary
Full outside off and angling in, punched down the ground to long-on
Short outside off, Rahane looks to pull but is beaten by the pace of this 146.6kph delivery
Rabada looks to whip away this length ball seaming in from outside off. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball goes behind point
Full outside off, he fends at it and gets an inside edge onto his pads. They get a single as Rabada goes to his left to collect
Oh, stunning! Not a bad ball by any margin. On a good length outside off. but Allen reads the length early on this 148.9kph delivery and uses his fast hands to swing it over midwicket
That's Allen at his best! Rabada serves up a slot ball outside off at 144kph. Allen picks it early and launches it down the ground, straight of mid-off
Full around off, driven out to deep point

Oh, Holder can't hold on to a tough chance at cover! I am immediately reminded of Powell's drop of Kohli in KKR's last game. Allen looks to go inside out on this length ball and hits it above Holder, but he's a tall man and leaps and gets an arm up, but the ball brushes his fingertips

And now he finds the gap on the leg side! This was full and straight, and nearly snuck past Allen's defence. But Allen gets an inside edge as he looks to whip it away leg side and gets it to backward square leg's left
Slashed over backward point! Back of length outside off, not quite a wide one there for the hitting, but Allen slashes at it nonetheless and clears the infield
And now Allen skips across this 137kph length ball and looks to scoop it but can't get bat on ball! The ball goes just over the bails
On a length around off, tucked to midwicket

Allen wasn't going to wait around for long! Siraj goes full on off at 138kph, and the ball is subtly swinging away. Allen looks to go down the ground and ends up slicing it. But gets enough on it to clear mid-off running back
Full around middle and off, 140.7kph, clipped out to deep square leg for a single
Taps this full ball through point for a quick run
Rahane uses his smarts and gets KKR's first six This is back of length outside off at 144.5kph, Rahane waits on it and opens his face and goes up and over backward point
Now Rahane slashes at a short and wide delivery fired i at 143kph. The ball swerves away and goes over the toe end of the bat
Wide outside off, on a good length. Slapped to cover
On a length outside off, Rahane parries and the ball goes towards short third
Length ball outside off, Allen looks to punch it away on the off side but gets a thick inside edge past the stumps and fine on the leg side. They pick up two as fielders give chase
On a length outside off, Rahane pushes at it with an open face and steers it to deep backward point's left
Full outside off, hint of that away movement again. Rahane taps it to cover
Now there's some movement! This is fuller side of good length outside off, and the ball swings away. Rahane shoulders arms
Full around middle and off, 135kph, tucked in front of square leg. Siraj pitching it up but not finding any movement yet
Full around middle, Rahane tucks it off his pads to deep backward square. KKR off the mark

edged behind. Raghuvanshi takes a low catch. Tewatia got across the stumps and went pulling at this rising short ball around middle. He swung too hard, and eventually fell to Green. KKR win by 29 runs, and keep their slim playoffs hopes alive
on a fullish length on off, and swung away to long-on
SS' fifty, but there's hardly anything to celebrate. Short in length, and angling in, as SS goes deep in the crease to pull for six over fine leg
good bounce off a length on middle and off. Pulled to long-on
Green sees SS coming, and bowls a slower ball very full on off. Driven to deep cover point
angled in, and on a length. Tewatia goes pulling but is hit on his body on leg. The ball rolls away for a leg bye
low full toss just outside off, and Tewatia goes down on his knee to swipe to deep midwicket

taken at long-off. Buttler knew he was gone the moment the ball left bat. Slower ball from Dubey, and around sixth stump. Buttler waits for the ball to come, and ends up lofting straight to the fielder, who took the catch well inside the field of play
goes for the slash off this length delivery a little wide of off. Slower ball too, and SS finds the point fielder
SS goes wide of long-off. Pandey cuts it off moving to his right. It was a short-of-a-length ball outside off, and SS mistimed his swat
this is wide. A short ball outside off, and there's too much bounce. SS leaps to try and upper cut, but misses
well bowled. Another dot ball. This is a yorker just outside off, and SS can't get bat on ball as he looks to jam his bat down
slower ball, and a dot. On a fullish length outside off, and SS gets a bottom edge as he looks to slash at it
six over extra cover. The ball flies off his bat. Full delivery around sixth stump, and Buttler eases through the shot after making room
he shapes to sweep, but is hit on his toe outside off. They take the leg bye as the ball rolls away
four wide of long-on. On a length on the stumps, and shaping away. SS reads the movement away, and the lack of pace, before slamming it across the line

ohh, no-ball called for height. It arrived around sixth stump, and above SS' waist. He went heaving, but missed. But hang on, KKR have reviewed. It's not a wide or a no-ball until it's a wide or a no-ball. We wait for the third umpire's confirmation. Wow, it's ruled as a fair delivery, although my first impression was that it was at par with SS' waist
dropped by Raghuvanshi!! But it wasn't all that east. He got his gloves to it as he dived to his left. SS got an outside edge as he looked to slog at this length ball finishing wide of off
massive six over wide long-on. SS reads this slower ball, which is also a bouncer just outside off. He gets on top of the bounce, and clatters it for six
full and slow, and just outside off. SS swings but gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep square leg
cut away to deep-backward point. SS plays the late cut at this length ball on off, which turns away
Buttler goes for the reverse sweep, but finds the man at short third. Length ball just outside off, and he mistimes one
SS swipes this length delivery outside leg to fine leg, even as the ball straightens

well-judged catch at fine leg!! Gill falls right after the break. Anukul at the boundary line tip-toed for a second, before completing the catch with a reverse cup. Gill has started to walk back, but the third umpire will still confirm the cleanliness of the catch. Anukul's back leg is extremely close to the boundary cushion, and the third umpire just wants to confirm if it tickled the boundary. Gill is made to wait. The third umpire wants to check different angles. He's finally satisfied, and rules Gill out. Gill went for the slog sweep off this length delivery, but fell short barely by a centimetre. That's how fine the margins can be
dot ball. He bowls this from around the wicket, and on a length on the stumps. The ball finishes outside off as Gill looks to loft

ohh, this turns out to be tight!! He barely makes it back in time even as the throw from deep cover point arrives, and the keeper whips the bails off. It's Buttler's fifty, by the way. He sliced this full ball outside off, and risked two
on the bounce to Rinku at long-on. A low full toss around off, and Gill swipes across the line. Missed chance for him
great execution. Tyagi fires a yorker on the stumps at 142kph. Buttler can only jam his bat down for a single to extra cover
beaten. Extra bounce for Tyagi, and this time Buttler can't get bat on ball. Short of a length and wide of off, and Buttler almost has a blind, cross-batted swing at it
dropped... by the ball boy!! Buttler goes over extra cover. Slower ball, and short and just outside off. This time Buttler backs away, and swats this hard for six

between the man at deep-backward square leg and deep midwicket. Short and around sixth stump, but Buttler rides the extra bounce. He pulls and just finds the gap even as the man at deep-backward square leg moved and dived to his left

beautiful bowling. Buttler is beaten, and so is the keeper, which allows a bye. Full and slow from Narine, who pitched it on leg, and got it to turn further down. Buttler looked to drive but missed, and the ball trickled off the keeper's gloves
another short ball, but this is angled across to finish outside off. Gill swats it back but mistimes to long-off
four to deep cover. Short ball to Gill, and wide-ish of off. Gill shifts his weight back last moment, and hacks it powerfully
down the pitch, and slammed wide of long-off. "Two, two", calls Gill, and gets it. It was a length ball just outside off, and Gill flat-batted it
fuller ball on middle and off, and pushed towards extra cover
misfield at point, but Green does well in the deep. Buttler cut away at this short ball on off, and beats point, but Green runs and slides to his left from deep point
but four still. Gill suddenly wears a "yeah, come on!" look. Varun bowls a length delivery wide of off, and Gill has all the room he needs to ram this ball up and over extra cover

short again, and six again. The sound off Gill's bat gave an idea as to how far that ball would be going. Varun bowled a legbreak outside leg, and the ball turned away. But Gill read it, and pulled it over midwicket
this time goes over Rahane, and gets four. Gill is down on his knees, and slashes this full and wide ball outside off. GT need plenty more of these
driven straight to Rahane at extra cover. He backs away, and drills this full ball on the stumps, but can't find the gap
crashed!! Short in length from Varun, and Gill pulls this from leg stump as the ball turns away from just outside leg. Six over deep square leg
the ball drops from over Rahane's head, as he turns halfway to his right and runs forward from extra cover. Gill went lofting at this full ball outside off, but couldn't dispatch it
fullish and wide of off. Gill shifts his weight back and drives to long-off
great effort by Pandey. He's at long-on, and runs and dives to his left to prevent a boundary. Gill slammed this length ball back rather forcefully
another slower ball. Buttler nearly scoops it to Narine at short fine leg. He goes for the scoop off this short-of-a-length ball outside off, but gets it to Narine on the bounce
Buttler misses again. On a length on middle and off, and good bounce, as the ball goes over the stumps after looks to slog but is beaten
an offcutter, and Buttler is beaten. On a length, and in the channel outside off. Buttler aimed for the slog, but missed
drilled through extra cover. Buttler waits for this slower ball on a short of a length to arrive around sixth stump, and rams it back hard
on a length on the stumps, and hinting to turn away at 108kph. Punched to deep cover point
the boundary finally comes, and through a misfield. It was the sub fielder Ramandeep at deep-backward square leg. Varun bowled it short, and Buttler pulled it powerfully from leg stump
slower this time. The length is also much fuller, as this pitches outside leg and hints to turn away. Clipped to deep-backward square leg
another single only. Short in length, and finishing wide of off. Hacked to deep point

short and outside leg, and Gill looks to pull but misses. Wide not called, and Gill reviews. We wait for the third umpire's first response. Varun bowled this one seam up, and it was the quicker one. Gill seemed to be still in the crease... and UltraEdge reveals the ball just missed brushing Gill's shirt. So it's called wide
full and really wide of off. Buttler gets a single to long-off by stretching his arms out
angles this across, and bowls on a fullish length. Pushed to extra cover for a hurried single

another wide yorker, but this time Buttler enjoys some luck. Tyagi bowls this around seventh stump, and Buttler reaches out and throws his bat at it, only to get a bottom edge past the stumps and the keeper
Tyagi keeps going at a lack of pace. This is on a short of a length and wide of off at 118kph. Gill cuts that to deep point to raise of a patient fifty
on a hard length, and on the stumps. Buttler gives himself room, and mistimes a pull to long-on
lovely bowling. Tyagi fires a yorker around sixth stump. Buttler looks to slam that away, but the length is too full, and the ball is too quick. So he misses
another slower ball. This is on the shorter side, and Buttler backs away to slash from just outside off to deep cover. Two more, but Buttler and GT need a lot more
ohh, he shapes for the scoop, but neds up getting it off the bottom of the bat towards midwicket. It was a slower ball on a length, and wide of off
Oh almost a mix-up! Length ball angled across him, he steers it to short third and wants a single but is sent back. Gets his bat in right in time
Full around leg, eased through midwicket and they easily pick up two. 100 up for GT
Full around off, clipped through backward square leg
Legbreak, but dropped too short and wide. Gill slaps it away through backward point and picks up his first boundary
On a length outside leg, swiped away through square leg
Flung full outside off, Buttler eases a drive through cover
Gill keeps attacking! This is too full again and Gill flat-bats this right back down the ground and well straight of long-off
Buttler skips out and whips this low full toss out to deep midwicket
Full outside leg, Gill misses his sweep but the ball goes off his pads to short fine leg's right

WHAM! Floated full and wide and Gill uses his big reach to get to that and hammer it inside out over extra cover. There was a fielder in the deep who was turned into a spectator, watching the ball sail over
Gill is so imperious when in form like this. Skips out of the crease to take on this full toss and lofts it straight back down the ground

Tossed full and wide, and it's just outside the wide line. Tough call, I felt. And KKR review it. Looked to me Anukul had just gotten away with it there. And it's a good review. The ball is seen to be inside the wide line there
Length ball slid across him, Gill steers it through cover point for a single
Length ball flashed across Gill, who cuts it and it goes to backward point on the bounce
Buttler wants to swing it away but Varun bowls it very full and doesn't let the batter get under that. The ball dribbles along the ground to deep midwicket
On a length around leg, Gill whips it away to deep midwicket's left. Green is swift and keeps it down to a single
Low full toss outside off, driven down to long-off
Full around leg, worked to deep midwicket
Flung on a length around middle, Buttler defends while taking a stride forward
On a length around off and spinning in, Gill works it to long-on
Dances down and puts it away! Jaw-dropping stuff. This is a length ball that spins in from outside off. Gill skips out of his crease and uses his wrists to flick this away over square leg
Better length from Narine and he blocks it back to the bowler's right
Gill with a mighty swipe! He played out four dots in Narine's last over, but now he goes after him. Narine goes full and wide and Gill gets down on one knee and slogs this over cow corner
Legbreak outside off, punched to cover
Short ball angled across, slapped to cover and they get a quick single. They finish the powerplay on KKR's exact score at this stage
Does well with this slower yorker on off. Buttler manages to squeeze it down to long-off
Back of length delivery around leg, Buttler punches it to cover
Short-ish ball angled across him, Gill crouches and cuts it away to deep point
Full and wide, 115.9kph, driven out to the off side sweeper
On a length on off, 145.5kph, Gill clips it towards midwicket and takes off for the single
Another offbreak that spins in some ways. Gill has to back away leg side as he tries to work it leg side and misses. The ball goes off his pads fine on the off side allowing a leg bye
Offbreak around off, beats the inside edge and raps Gill's pads. but that was doing too much
Slightly short outside off, Gill hits a drive on the bounce to cover
Length ball spins in from outside off. Gill looks to block and gets an inside edge onto his pads. Raghuvanshi reckons there was no bat and goes up in appeal
On a length outside off, Buttler taps it through midwicket for a single

And Narine strikes right away! Sindhu has miscued this straight to long-off. Tossed up full outside off, inviting him to take it on. Sindhu tries to go over long-off but can't quite get under it. Manish Pandey has to run in from the rope and take a low catch, and as one of the best fielders the IPL has seen, he makes no mistake

Oh, glorious! Leans into this full delivery outside off and hits a thumping drive between cover and mid-off. Ball was fired in at 141kph, but Gill seemed to have all the time in the world to play that shot
On a length outside off, 131kph, punched to cover
Pathirana fires this full ball down the leg side
Full around off, Gill tucks it towards midwicket
Bouncer on leg at 143kph, Sindhu is done in there as he hopefully tries to swing it away. The ball goes high but drops short of deep square leg
Sindhu goes driving after this full ball that's fired in at 141.4kph and is beaten on the outside edge
Flung full on off, 139.6kph, Sindhu blocks
Looks for a wide yorker to start, but gets it too wide

Looks like he's hurt there. Length ball speared into him from outside off, Sudharsan looks to work it leg side but seems to cop a blow on the elbow. As the ball deflects through square leg, he gets up after being knocked down onto the ground and scampers through for the single. Immediately gets on the ground in pain. And replays confirm that hit him plumb on the elbow. Ouch!
He went a bit wild there, with a full ball sliding down leg. Sudharsan got something on it as he looked to glance it away but it's well stoppped at short fine leg
Now Tyagi goes on a length outside off and seaming away past the outside edge
Punched away in the gap now! Reaches out to this slightly short delivery with some width on offer. Pierces the gap between cover and point
Just clears deep backward square leg! 137kph bumper cramps him for room and he takes it on with the swivel-and-pull. Pathirana gets under it moving to his left, but he's hit it just high enough
Cracking drive! Overpitched outside off, Sai Sudharsan gets down on one knee and drills it away between cover and point
Looks for the wide yorker. Sai Sudharsan reaches out and gets an inside edge to short fine's right
Full outside off, punched towards mid-on for a quick run
Spanked away over cover! Just short of good length outside off and Gill dances down while moving leg side and slaps it away inside out

Oh, that's missed everything, even as the KKR players go up in appeal! Back of length ball jags in a long way to cut Gill in half. Beats his inside edge and goes over the stumps. Raghuvanshi dives and makes a good stop
On a length outside off, blocked towards cover
Length ball angled across, grazes the pads and beats Raghuvanshi's dive and races away for four
That's probably his best ball of the day. Length ball outside off, but close enough to not give the batter room to free his arms. Sai Sudharsan tries to punch it away but can't connect
Another wide on the off side as Dubey goes full and tries to take it away from Sai Sudharsan's arc
And now Dubey goes too wide with this length ball

Length ball outside off, Sai Sudharsan punches it with an open face to steer it through backward point. Deep point races to his right and puts in the dive, but the ball races over the practice fields and he can't stop it
And now he errs line line again. On a length and sliding down leg. Raghuvanshi dives but he can't get there
Full and straight and Sai Sudharsan capitalises! Easy pickings as he clips it through the vacant square leg region off his pads
Full and wide, Sai Sudharsan launches himself into a flowing cover drive, but hits it straight to the fielder
Full outside off, he eases it to cover
On a length outside off, SaiSu drops it to his left but the bowler charges it down quickly and prevents a single
